result: Narrowed: conditional mathematical continuum result; original OPEN node retained. For a supplied finite discrete label alphabet and normalized nonnegative probability laws on every finite set of natural-number coordinates, compatibility under coordinate restriction is equivalent to existence of an infinite projective-limit measure. Under compatibility, that probability measure is unique. Every countable family of measurable finite-window constraints having mass one in its finite law holds almost everywhere simultaneously in the limit, and at least one satisfying infinite configuration exists. The theorem specializes to the three level-two spin labels Fin 3 and arbitrary predicates on their finite windows.
proof_boundary: The alphabet, discrete topology, product measurable structure, compatible finite probability laws and full-mass constraint premises are supplied. Physical LQG or complex spin-foam amplitudes are not shown to satisfy them. No triangulation refinement, manifold, semiclassical geometry, Einstein dynamics or physical cosmological constant is derived; the original node and physical routes remain OPEN/GAP.
